title: dashboards and reports waste the first screen: "Refresh All" takes a grid row of its own (~120px band under the filter bar), and report tables sit in a fixed-height empty card
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect — `reach:` every console dashboard, measured in the browser; separate card under the maintainer's quota exception (provenance below).
Reader: objectui triage first-touch → `domain:ui` lane (`packages/plugin-dashboard`, `packages/plugin-report`); one PR.
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed, objectui): "dashboard Refresh All button occupies its own row, empty vertical space between filter bar and widgets" → 4 hits, all closed, none about layout (objectui#11097 notes the button is on every dashboard since objectui#11062).

Environment: framework `ce577ec4` showcase booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on its own port and SQLite file; console = objectui `f9f4a62d` (`apps/console` Vite dev server, and a production `vite build` for timings); Chromium 141 headless, 1440×900, seeded admin.

## Repro

1. Showcase → Analytics → Delivery Operations (`/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard`).
2. Actual: the filter bar ("Last 90 days", "Task Status: All") sits on one row; below it an empty band of ~120px holds only a right-aligned "Refresh All" button; the KPI row starts under that. At 1440×900 the first row of charts is pushed below the fold.
3. Same band on Revenue Pulse, Chart Gallery (no filter bar — the button still takes a row of its own) and Setup → System Overview.
4. Reports (Analytics → Hours by Status, Status × Priority, Task Overview): a 5–7 row table renders inside a much taller bordered card, leaving most of the card empty.

## Where

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx` — `refreshButton` is a `flex justify-end mb-2` block with `col-span-full`, rendered as an item of the widget grid (so it gets a full grid row plus the grid gap), separate from the filter bar above the grid.
- `packages/plugin-report/src/LegacyReportRenderer.tsx` — containers with `min-h-[300px]` / `min-h-[100px]` (likely the report-card height; not instrumented in this run).

## Expected

"Refresh All" shares the filter bar's row (right-aligned), adding no row of its own; a report card is as tall as its content.

Provenance: filed as a separate card on the maintainer's explicit instruction in the dispatching session, which lifts the per-fire filing quota for this batch of seven, verbatim — 「重新思考以上和用户体验相关的问题，哪些需要立卡」 then 「分开立 7 张」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; companion checklist card objectstack-ai/objectui#11672. Filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
